core_obligations: (1): the three conditions are equivalent because after a smooth presentation the relative inertia becomes a group space over the presentation whose identity section is the base change of the identity of the inertia, and a group space is separated exactly when its identity section is a closed immersion, while the second diagonal is by definition the diagonal of the first (proof lines 1641-1653)

(4) and (5): the pullback of the first diagonal along a test morphism into the square of the stack is the isomorphism space of the given pair with the prescribed two-morphism, which is a pseudo torsor over the pullback of the inertia, and the corresponding implications for pseudo torsors give the equivalence between unramifiedness, respectively local quasi-finiteness, of the diagonal and the same property of the relative inertia (proof lines 1654-1697)
proof_roadmap: (1)：取 U → X 满光滑，则 G = U ×_X I_{X/Y} 是 U 上群代数空间，且 e 的基变换是 G/U 的单位截面；由「群概型分离 ⟺ 单位截面闭浸入」得 (a)⟺(c)，而 Δ_{f,2} 就是 Δ_f 的对角 ⇒ (b)⟺(c)。
(4)(5)：任取 a: Z → X ×_Y X，写 a = (x_1, x_2, α)；两个方块是笛卡尔的，Isom^α_{X/Y}(x_1,x_2) 是 Isom_{X/Y}(x_2,x_2) 上的伪挠子 ⇒ 由伪挠子的相应蕴含关系得 Δ_f unramified / 局部拟有限 ⟺ I_{X/Y} → X 有同性质。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows three equivalent conditions expressing separatedness of the relative inertia through the two diagonals, and further conditions expressing unramifiedness and local quasi-finiteness of the diagonal through the relative inertia (author lemma at source lines 1584-1639, label lemma-diagonal-diagonal). The proof (source lines 1641-1698) presents the source and identifies the relative inertia with a group space over the presentation, so that separatedness becomes the closedness of the identity section, and identifies the two diagonals with the two isomorphism spaces of a test morphism, which form a pseudo torsor over the inertia, before applying the corresponding pseudo torsor statements (proof lines 1641-1697). The reduction to a group space over a presentation and the pseudo torsor comparison are the substance. H3.
